title: Trail-Weighted Influence Scores for Approximate Outcome Prediction in Bayesian Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.27366v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study trail-weighted pruning of evidence for Bayesian-network prediction. A traversal enumerates the active trails from each evidence node to the outcome, scores each trail by the product of its edge strengths, and drops evidence whose score falls below a threshold. For collider-free networks (chains and forks) over binary variables, we show that the trail score equals the exact correlation between a trail's endpoints, that a chain and a fork with equal edge strengths have identical joint distributions, and that the pruned posterior is within a computable sum of per-trail terms of the exact posterior when each dropped trail lies in its own branch of the outcome node. We prove this bound, check it exhaustively on all small trees, and show that it fails when dropped trails share a branch. translated_title: 贝叶斯网络中用于近似结果预测的迹加权影响分数
translated_abstract: 我们研究了用于贝叶斯网络预测的证据迹加权剪枝方法。该方法通过遍历枚举从每个证据节点到结果节点的活跃迹，用每条迹的边强度乘积对迹进行评分，并舍弃得分低于阈值的证据。对于二值变量上的无碰撞节点网络（链和分叉结构），我们证明了迹得分等于迹两端点之间的精确相关性，具有相同边强度的链与分叉具有相同的联合分布，并且当每条被剪除的迹位于结果节点各自的分支中时，剪枝后的后验与精确后验之间的差异处于一个可计算的逐迹项之和的范围内。我们证明了这个界限，在所有小树上进行了穷举验证，并展示了当被剪除的迹共享同一分支时该界限会失效。在随机树上的模拟实验中，对迹得分进行阈值筛选相比相同规模的随机剪枝可将误差降低1.4至13倍。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于迹加权影响分数的证据剪枝方法用于贝叶斯网络近似预测，证明了无碰撞节点网络中迹得分与端点精确相关性相等，并给出了剪枝后验误差的可计算界限，实验表明其误差比随机剪枝低1.4至13倍。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes trail-weighted influence scores for evidence pruning in approximate Bayesian-network outcome prediction, proves that trail scores equal exact endpoint correlations in collider-free networks and derives a computable error bound for the pruned posterior, achieving 1.4 to 13 times lower error than random pruning in simulations.
